items.name: Visibility toggle
items.evidence: New op `set_visible`. A BasePart has no Visible property, so hiding writes Transparency = 1 after remembering the old value in the `AppleHiddenTransparency` attribute, and showing restores THAT value rather than snapping to 0 (which would turn every translucent window into plastic). Hiding twice is idempotent; a part the companion never hid is left alone; a GuiObject takes .Visible and is counted separately; anything else is reported as skipped. apps/plugin/tests/companion.spec.luau: 5 cases. Mutations `hiding an already-hidden part overwrites what it looked like` and `showing a part snaps it to fully opaque instead of restoring it` both caught — proven by apps/plugin/tests/companion.test.mjs, apps/plugin/tests/companion.spec.luau, apps/worker/tests/companion-selection.test.mjs

Tests: tests/memory-store.test.mjs 'every change is recorded, with what it was before', 'a delete on a scope the caller cannot write is refused and removes nothing', 'deleting something that is not there is not an error, and is not an audit line either' — proven by apps/worker/tests/memory-store.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/preferences.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs

items.name: Memory expiration
items.evidence: expiresAtFor()/isExpired()/read-time SQL exclusion/purgeExpired() in apps/worker/src/memory-store.ts; ttlDays input in instructions-panel.tsx. Tests: tests/memory-store.test.mjs 'expiry is enforced at READ time, not by a sweeper that may not have run' (falsified by removing both filters -> red), 'a TTL that is not a finite number is refused, not silently treated as "never"', 'a write with a bad TTL stores NOTHING', 'the sweeper removes only what has expired' — proven by apps/worker/tests/memory-store.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/preferences.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs

items.name: Memory import
items.evidence: parseImport() in apps/worker/src/memory-store.ts targets the URL scope, never the envelope; POST /api/memory/:scope/:scopeId/import; file input in instructions-panel.tsx reporting imported and refused counts. Tests: tests/memory-store.test.mjs "another project's bundle cannot be imported into this one", 'an envelope that lies about its own scope cannot launder a row by agreeing with itself', 'an imported row cannot pollute Object.prototype through its key'; tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs 'import targets the URL, never the envelope' (falsified -> red) — proven by apps/worker/tests/memory-store.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/preferences.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs

items.name: Memory export
items.evidence: buildExport()/MEMORY_EXPORT_FORMAT in apps/worker/src/memory-store.ts; GET /api/memory/:scope/:scopeId/export (attachment, private no-store); downloadMemoryExport() in apps/web/src/lib/api.ts. Tests: tests/memory-store.test.mjs 'an export round-trips into the SAME scope'; tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs 'an export is a private download, not something a shared cache may keep' and 'the export download carries the token, because an anchor cannot' — proven by apps/worker/tests/memory-store.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/preferences.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs

items.name: Memory audit
items.evidence: memory_audit table + appendAudit()/readMemoryAudit() in apps/worker/src/memory-store.ts; GET /api/memory/:scope/:scopeId/audit; History section in instructions-panel.tsx. Tests: tests/memory-store.test.mjs 'every change is recorded, with what it was before', 'the audit of a scope the caller cannot read is not readable either', 'a write to a project the caller has not proven is refused and leaves no row and no audit' — proven by apps/worker/tests/memory-store.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/preferences.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs

items.name: Memory permissions
items.evidence: canReadScope()/canWriteScope() in apps/worker/src/memory-store.ts (org read is wider than org write; user and project scopes have one principal each) plus memoryScopeAccess() in index.ts, which proves project ownership via getOwnedProject before any row is touched. Tests: tests/memory-store.test.mjs 'a scope that is not one of the three is refused before any id is compared'; tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs 'every scoped-memory route proves the scope before it touches a row' and 'project scope is proven by an ownership query, not by the id in the URL' (falsified -> red) — proven by apps/worker/tests/memory-store.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/preferences.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs

items.name: Memory conflict resolution
items.evidence: resolveMemoryLayers()/precedenceOf() in apps/worker/src/memory-store.ts (org < user < project, shadowed list reported) and mergePreferences()/mostRestrictive() in preferences.ts (tool permissions intersect to the strictest instead of overriding). Tests: tests/memory-store.test.mjs 'the nearest layer wins, and the layers it beat are reported in precedence order', 'a row carrying a scope nobody defined is surfaced as invalid'; tests/preferences.test.mjs 'a lower layer cannot WIDEN a tool denial from a higher one' — proven by apps/worker/tests/memory-store.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/preferences.test.mjs, apps/worker/tests/memory-personalisation.test.mjs
